request.text: Quiet haunted library at night: soft airy room tone, a slow grandfather clock ticking far away, an occasional gentle creak of old wooden bookshelves, faint wind sighing past tall windows, a rare soft page turn. Calm and hushed. No crackling, no rustling leaves, no footsteps. Seamless loop. Wide, airy, natural ambience recording of the whole space, soft and even, no sudden loud sounds. No music, no speech, no voice.
